concepts.title: Obsidian
concepts.logline: Darkness, metal and water: the bottle is discovered one hard edge of light at a time until it stands whole on wet rock.
concepts.visual_hook: A razor line of light crawling over a brushed metal cap
concepts.insight: Real confidence is quiet; it shows in details, not noise.
concepts.differentiator: Pure material and light; no story, no character until one hand at the end.

concepts.title: Night Rain
concepts.logline: Rain on a midnight terrace beads on cold glass while the city hum fades; one drop at a time builds to the scent.
concepts.visual_hook: A single raindrop landing on a leaf in extreme slow motion
concepts.insight: The best nights start in the quiet minutes before you leave.
concepts.differentiator: Built around weather and the city at night instead of pure material.

concepts.title: Desert Ember
concepts.logline: Wind-carved sandstone and the last ember of a majlis fire glow behind the bottle as heat shimmers past it.
concepts.visual_hook: An ember's glow sweeping over carved sandstone
concepts.insight: Heritage is warm; it is carried, not displayed.
concepts.differentiator: Warm desert palette and heritage materials instead of cold water and metal.
